    (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ) (x y : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hx : StrictMono x) (hy : StrictMono y)
    (hxp : ∀ j : ℤ, x (j + Int.ofNat n) = x j + p)
    (hyp : ∀ j : ℤ, y (j + Int.ofNat n) = y j + q)
    (hxc : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ j : ℤ, x j ≤ z ∧ z < x (j + 1))
    (hyc : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ j : ℤ, y j ≤ z ∧ z < y (j + 1)) :
    ∃ H : ℝ ≃ₜ ℝ,
      StrictMono H ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, H (x j) = y j) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, H (z + p) = H z + q)

statement:
theorem approximation_boundedMetricAndRelationControl :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ (M η : ℝ) (normals : Finset RationalNormal), 0 < M → 0 < η →
      ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          Set.InjOn (deformPoint φ) Y ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, dist a b < M →
            dist (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b) (a - b) < η) ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
            dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 → dist a b < M) ∧
          (∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
            dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 →
              ∀ n ∈ normals,
                normalEval n (deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b) = 0 ↔
                  normalEval n (a - b) = 0)

  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < 1 → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y,
          ‖deformPoint φ (a - b) - (a - b)‖ ≤ c * dist a b

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_lineRelativeError

theorem approximation_lineRelativeError :
  ∀ (T : Set Plane) (W : Finset Plane) (n : RationalNormal) (a : Plane),
    W.Nonempty → Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T →
    (∀ t ∈ T, normalEval n (t - a) = 0) →
    (∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ z : Plane, normalEval n (z - a) = 0 →
      ∃ t ∈ T, dist z t < ρ) →
      ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < 1 → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
          ∀ x ∈ (W : Set Plane) + T, ∀ y ∈ (W : Set Plane) + T,
            ‖deformPoint φ (x - y) - (x - y)‖ ≤ c * dist x y

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_preservesFLC
statement:
theorem approximation_preservesFLC :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC (deformPoint φ '' Y)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_reflectsBoundedDisplacement
statement:
theorem approximation_reflectsBoundedDisplacement :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ M : ℝ, 0 < M → ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ a ∈ Y, ∀ b ∈ Y, ∀ c ∈ Y, ∀ d ∈ Y,
          dist (deformPoint φ a) (deformPoint φ b) < M / 2 →
          dist (deformPoint φ c) (deformPoint φ d) < M / 2 →
            (((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).re =
                (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).re) ↔ (a - b).re = (c - d).re) ∧
            (((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b).im =
                (deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d).im) ↔ (a - b).im = (c - d).im) ∧
            ((deformPoint φ a - deformPoint φ b = deformPoint φ c - deformPoint φ d) ↔
              a - b = c - d)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.approximation_uniformImageDensity
statement:
theorem approximation_uniformImageDensity :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∃ F : Finset ℝ, ∃ ε ρ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, IsFiniteApproximation F ε φ →
        ∀ z : Plane, ∃ y ∈ deformPoint φ '' Y, dist z y < ρ

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.boundedSteps_generate
statement:
theorem boundedSteps_generate :
  ∀ Y : Set Plane, Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC Y → RelativeDense Y →
    ∀ y₀ ∈ Y, ∃ steps : Finset Plane, (steps : Set Plane) ⊆ Y - Y ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Y, y - y₀ ∈ AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane)

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.commonMesh_of_finiteZGeneration
statement:
theorem commonMesh_of_finiteZGeneration :
  ∀ (steps : Finset Plane) (φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ), ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧
    deformPoint φ '' (AddSubgroup.closure (steps : Set Plane) : Set Plane) ⊆ RationalMesh d

name: Tiling.RationalSlopes.Approximation.flcApproximation_commonMesh
statement:
theorem flcApproximation_commonMesh :
  ∀ (T : Set Plane) (V : Finset Plane), 0 ∈ T →
    Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC T → RelativeDense T →
      ∀ φ : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ, ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧
        deformPoint φ '' (T ∪ (V : Set Plane)) ⊆ RationalMesh d

name: Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.locallyFell_limit_of_translates
statement:
theorem _root_.Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC.locallyFell_limit_of_translates
    {S L : Set Plane} {u : ℕ → Plane} (hS : Tiling.Polygonal.HasFLC S)
    (hconv : LocallyFellConverges (fun n => u n +ᵥ S) L) :

name: Tiling.Topology.exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
statement:
theorem exists_locallyFellConvergent_subsequence
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (S : ℕ → Set Plane)
    (hclosed : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n))
    (hsep : ∀ n, IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n)) :
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (L : Set Plane), StrictMono φ ∧ IsClosed L ∧
      IsUniformlySeparated δ L ∧ LocallyFellConverges (S ∘ φ) L

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_disjoint_compact
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L C : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    (hC : IsCompact C) (hLC : Disjoint L C) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (A n) C

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
statement:
theorem locallyFellConverges_eventually_exists_mem_ball
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    {x : Plane} (hx : x ∈ L) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ y ∈ A n, dist y x < ε

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_iff_hit_miss
statement:
theorem locallyFell_iff_hit_miss (S : ℕ → Set Plane) (L : Set Plane) :
    LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      (∀ n, IsClosed (S n)) ∧ IsClosed L ∧
      (∀ x ∈ L, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ y ∈ S n, dist y x < ε) ∧
      (∀ C : Set Plane, IsCompact C → Disjoint L C →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Disjoint (S n) C)

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_linearImage_iff
statement:
theorem locallyFell_linearImage_iff (A : Plane ≃L[ℝ] Plane)
    (S : ℕ → Set Plane) (L : Set Plane) :
    LocallyFellConverges (fun n => A '' S n) (A '' L) ↔
      LocallyFellConverges S L

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_matchingPoints
statement:
theorem locallyFell_matchingPoints
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {S : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane}
    (hclosedS : ∀ n, IsClosed (S n)) (hclosedL : IsClosed L)
    (hsepS : ∀ n, IsUniformlySeparated δ (S n))
    (hsepL : IsUniformlySeparated δ L) :
    LocallyFellConverges S L ↔
      ∀ C : Set Plane, IsCompact C → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < δ / 3 →
        ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
          (∀ x ∈ L ∩ C, ∃! y : Plane, y ∈ S n ∧ dist x y < ε) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ S n ∩ C, ∃! x : Plane, x ∈ L ∧ dist x y < ε)

name: Tiling.Topology.locallyFell_translate
statement:
theorem locallyFell_translate
    {S : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges S L)
    {g : ℕ → Plane} {u : Plane} (hg : Tendsto g atTop (𝓝 u)) :
    LocallyFellConverges (fun n => g n +ᵥ S n) (u +ᵥ L)

name: Tiling.Topology.mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_locallyFellConverges_of_tendsto_mem
    {A : ℕ → Set Plane} {L : Set Plane} (hconv : LocallyFellConverges A L)
    {zseq : ℕ → Plane} {z : Plane} (hzmem : ∀ n, zseq n ∈ A n)
    (hzlim : Tendsto zseq atTop (𝓝 z)) : z ∈ L
